sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Incident Response Plan establishes the operational capability of {org_name} to prepare for, detect, analyze, contain, recover from, and respond to security incidents affecting {system_name}. It applies to the system boundary described as {boundary}, and to incidents involving Controlled Unclassified Information, specifically {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Roles, Officials, and Authorities

questions.prompt: Who directs incident response (role or title)?
Which internal organizational officials must be notified of incidents (roles or titles)?
Which external authorities must be notified (for example DoD DIBNet, FBI, US-CERT), and under what conditions is each one notified?

sections.body: Incident response is directed by {ir_lead_role}. The organizational officials to whom incidents are reported are {internal_officials}. The external authorities to whom incidents are reported, and the conditions under which each is notified, are {external_authorities}.

sections.heading: 3. Incident-Handling Capability

questions.prompt: How does the organization prepare to handle incidents (training, tooling, runbooks, on-call)?
How are incidents detected (monitoring, alerting, user reports)?
How are detected events analyzed and confirmed as incidents (triage, severity)?
How are incidents contained to limit impact?
How are affected systems recovered to normal operation?
What user response activities occur (how affected users are informed and directed)?

sections.body: {org_name} maintains an operational incident-handling capability spanning the full incident lifecycle. Preparation is carried out through {preparation}. Detection is performed through {detection}. Analysis and confirmation follow {analysis}. Containment is achieved through {containment}. Recovery is performed through {recovery}. User response activities consist of {user_response}.

sections.heading: 4. Tracking, Documentation, and Reporting

questions.prompt: Where are incidents tracked (ticketing system, register)?
What is documented for each incident (timeline, actions, evidence, disposition)?
Within what timeline are officials and authorities notified after an incident is confirmed?
By what method are officials and authorities notified (portal, email, phone)?

sections.body: All incidents are tracked in {tracking_system}. Each incident is documented as follows: {documentation_practice}. The identified organizational officials and external authorities are notified within {reporting_timeline}, using {reporting_method}.

sections.heading: 5. Testing and Improvement

questions.prompt: How often is the incident response capability tested (for example annually)?
How is it tested (tabletop exercise, functional exercise, simulation)?

sections.body: The incident response capability is tested {test_frequency} using {test_method}. The results of each test are recorded and used to improve this plan.
